W85_N35.rd5 is a routing data file for tests: a five-by-five grid of roads north-east of Charlotte,
with one farm track and one footpath (roads.txt lists them). It was made with BRouter's own
map-creation code (OsmFastCutter, PosUnifier, WayLinker) from roads.txt; only the reader of the
input file was replaced, so the file is in the real rd5 format. It holds no OpenStreetMap data.
